legend: You are given an integer array a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$, and two integers k$$$k$$$ and q$$$q$$$. Please answer the following q$$$q$$$ queries:

For each query, you are given two integers l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$. Your task is to determine whether there exists a nonempty subset of {al,al+1,...,ar}$$$\{a_l, a_{l + 1}, ..., a_r\}$$$ whose bitwise AND is equal to exactly k$$$k$$$.

We define the bitwise AND of a nonempty integer subset {b1,b2,...,bm}$$$\{b_1, b_2, ..., b_m\}$$$ to be b1$$$b_1$$$ if m=1$$$m = 1$$$, and b1 AND b2 AND ... AND bm$$$b_1 \text{ AND } b_2 \text{ AND } ... \text{ AND } b_m$$$ otherwise.
input: The first line of input consists of three space-separated integers n$$$n$$$, k$$$k$$$, and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤2⋅105$$$(1 \leq n, q \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, 0≤k<230)$$$0 \leq k  \lt  2^{30})$$$.
The second line consists of n$$$n$$$ space-separated integers a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$ (0≤ai<230)$$$(0 \leq a_i  \lt  2^{30})$$$.
The next q$$$q$$$ lines each consist of two space-separated integers l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$ (1≤l≤r≤n)$$$(1 \leq l \leq r \leq n)$$$.
output: Output q$$$q$$$ lines. On the i$$$i$$$th line, output YES if the answer to the i$$$i$$$th query is yes, and NO otherwise.
note: In the first sample test case, the answer to the first query is YES, since 6 AND 10=2$$$6 \text{ AND } 10 = 2$$$.
There is no nonempty subset of {1,6}$$$\{1, 6\}$$$ with AND equal to 2$$$2$$$, so the answer to the second query is NO.
For the third query, the subset {2}$$$\{2\}$$$ can be picked.
